lead_raw_text:
The structure of K2Ti2Fe4O12 (KTi(FeO3)2) crystallizes in orthorhombic symmetry with space group Amm2 (No. 38) and a 20-atom unit cell containing 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Fe and Ti centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while K shows 8-fold oxygen coordination and O centers are four- or five-coordinate. Corner-sharing between Fe and Ti octahedra, and edge-sharing among Fe octahedra, are observed. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 20 sites.
